ns2:course.label: Euro Intl Affairs Since 1914
ns2:course.description: (HIST 319) History of European international affairs from the First World War to the present day, concentrating on political developments, especially the two world wars, but including the impact of domestic politics, ideological struggle, and socio-economic change upon foreign policy. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One year of college history or consent of instructor.
